# EasySpin function authors

*Generated by `porting/tools/gen_easyspin_authors.py` from `porting/easyspin_authors.json`; do not edit.*

EasySpyn is a translation of [EasySpin](https://easyspin.org) 6.0.15, Copyright (c) 2006-2024 Stefan Stoll and other contributors, MIT licence (the notice is in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE)). EasySpin's function headers do not list authors, so the record used here is the Git history of each original file at the release tag [v6.0.15](https://github.com/StollLab/EasySpin/tree/v6.0.15): the people who authored commits to it, in order of the number of commits, together with any author the source itself names (code taken from elsewhere). The lists therefore include everyone who changed a file, small edits as well as large ones, and do not say who wrote which algorithm. The same lines are in the docstrings (`help(easyspyn.pepper)`). Function names are EasySpin's and are not changed to carry authors.

How an EasySpyn function relates to its original:

- **port**: a translation of the EasySpin function of that name;
- **derived**: translated from part of an EasySpin file, a private helper, or a different implementation of what it computes (the compiled kernels are rewritten in NumPy);
- **new**: no EasySpin counterpart.
